extracted.name: Green Pea Salad
extracted.description: This easy pea salad recipe tosses green peas with crunchy almonds, green onions, and cheese in a sweet and creamy dressing for a super summer salad.
instruction_lines: Place peas in a colander, and run warm water over them until they are thawed; drain and transfer into a large bowl.
Toast almonds in a skillet over medium heat until nuts start to turn golden brown and become fragrant, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Add almonds, green onions, cheese, and mayonnaise to peas. Stir in balsamic vinegar, and season to taste with black pepper.
